other_failure_modes.name: Ignoring target outliers
other_failure_modes.description: The agent makes no effort to filter or clip extreme outliers in the target variable before training. In datasets like NYC Taxi, anomalous trip durations (e.g., several days long or under a minute) can heavily distort a regression model, even when log-transformed.

summary: The agent implements a generally solid pipeline, utilizing a well-parameterized LightGBM model, 5-fold cross-validation, and strong geographical feature engineering. However, it fails to account for the temporal nature of the data during splitting (FM05) and misses a critical dataset-specific step by failing to filter extreme outliers in the trip duration target.
